SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT - Schedule C to the Hosting Agreement between Ardent Analytics Ltd (Customer) and Nimbus Forge Ltd (Provider)

C1. Monthly Uptime % = (Total Minutes - Downtime Minutes) / Total Minutes x 100, where Total Minutes is the number of minutes in the calendar month.
C2. Downtime Minutes are minutes in which the Production API is unavailable. The API is unavailable in a minute if more than 25% of requests in that minute fail with server errors.
C3. Excluded from Downtime: (a) Scheduled Maintenance; (b) unavailability caused by Customer's own systems, configuration or instructions; (c) any unavailability of Customer's sandbox or staging environments.
C4. Scheduled Maintenance means the minutes of a maintenance event that fall inside the Maintenance Window (Saturday or Sunday, 01:00-05:00 UTC), provided Provider announced the event at least 5 business days in advance. Minutes of a maintenance event outside the Maintenance Window, and all minutes of maintenance announced with shorter notice, count as Downtime if the API is unavailable.
C5. Service credits, as a percentage of the monthly fee for the affected month:
  Monthly Uptime 99.90% or higher: no credit
  99.50% to below 99.90%: 5%
  99.00% to below 99.50%: 10%
  below 99.00%: 25%
C6. Customer must request credits in writing within 30 days after the end of the affected month.
Amendment 1 (effective 1 October 2026): in C5, the no-credit threshold becomes 99.95%.

INCIDENT LOG - September 2026 (all times UTC)
#1 Fri 4 Sep, 14:12-14:50: production database failover; 100% of production requests failing (38 min).
#2 Sat 12 Sep, 01:30-04:30: maintenance announced on Tue 1 Sep; production API down (180 min).
#3 Tue 15 Sep, 09:00-10:35: Customer pushed an invalid IP allow-list through its own admin console; all of Customer's production requests rejected (95 min).
#4 Sun 20 Sep, 03:30-06:10: maintenance announced on Tue 8 Sep; production API down for the whole event (160 min).
#5 Tue 22 Sep, 16:00-16:50: degraded performance; 18% of production requests failing (50 min).
#6 Sat 26 Sep, 02:00-02:45: maintenance announced on Wed 23 Sep; production API down (45 min).
#7 Tue 29 Sep, 11:05-11:47: Customer's staging environment down; production unaffected (42 min).
#8 Wed 30 Sep, 20:10-21:05: network fault; 40% of production requests failing (55 min).

Customer's written credit request for September was sent on 5 October 2026.
Customer's covering email: "By our count the API was down 665 minutes in September, so we expect the 25% credit."
